runners_data.name: Collateral Damage
runners_data.spotlight: By Too Darn Hot; 270,000gns foal; first foal; dam 1m AW winner; interesting newcomer who should be checked in the market.

runners_data.name: Rogue Passion
runners_data.spotlight: 90,000euros yearling; first foal; by Sioux Nation out of a 7.5f/10.3f winner; worth monitoring in the market on her debut.

runners_data.name: Wilbur
runners_data.spotlight: 160,000euros yearling by Kingman out of a 1m juvenile winner; promising 2.75l fourth of ten on last month's Newbury debut (6f, good; 16-1, not getting the best of runs); 7f should suit; improvement likely.

runners_data.name: Sou'wester
runners_data.spotlight: Has shown a degree of promise, notably when 6l fifth of seven on his Redcar debut (7f, good; 40-1); pulled hard and hung left at Beverley last time (7.5f, good to firm; 16-1) but this track should suit him better.

runners_data.name: Leave The Bag In
runners_data.comment: Encouraging start with running-on eighth at York; capable of better, especially over 7f
runners_data.spotlight: Ran green when eighth on her debut in a York novice (6f, good; 16-1) but didn't improve on that when seventh in a valuable Thirsk novice last time (7f, good; 8-1); this is easier.

races.name: Bowel Cancer Screening Programme Saves Lives Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Alpha Platoon
runners_data.comment: Useful sprinting pedigree; attracted no interest at the sales last September; best watched
runners_data.spotlight: 55,000gns yearling; second foal of 6f AW winner (RPR 100); gelded half-brother to the 5f juvenile scorer Ain't Nobody (including Listed; 114); best watched on debut, with various question marks lingering.

runners_data.name: Two Commanders
runners_data.comment: Half-brother to four winners at up to 1m2f; interesting newcomer; worth a market check
runners_data.spotlight: Half-brother to four winners; did as well as could be expected when a weakening third over 7f here (maiden, good to firm; 17-2) 12 days ago; dropping back to 6f should be fine, although the ground conditions are now likely to be slower; chance.

runners_data.name: Lamlash Bay
runners_data.comment: Lots of winners in the family but tailed off on last month's turf debut.
runners_data.spotlight: Struggled on Redcar debut (6f, good; 150-1) last November, but better at Southwell (6f; 80-1, fourth of eight, beaten 7l) the following month; eligible for a handicap mark after this comeback run.

runners_data.name: Nursia
runners_data.comment: Well held on 2yo debut but picked up well to win over C&D in January; plenty more to come
runners_data.spotlight: Cosy Newcastle AW winner (6f novice; 13-8) in January; that form isn't easy to evaluate, the runner-up winning two Class 5 handicaps since, but the odds-on favourite (third) has yet to reappear; carries a penalty for that, and returns to turf as a gelding after a break.

runners_data.name: Sugar Bon Bon
runners_data.comment: Trainer not noted for first-time-out winners on the Flat
runners_data.spotlight: Dam was a 6f-7f winner; fifth of nine on Southwell debut (6f novice; 200-1, beaten 9l) six weeks ago; could build on that now switched to turf, but others tick more boxes at this stage of his career.

runners_data.name: Lady Gormire
runners_data.comment: Failed to build on debut promise when eighth at Doncaster for Kevin Ryan; not written off
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten 12l when runner-up on debut for Kevin Ryan; joined this trainer for 12,000gns, and made a solid start when runner-up in maiden fillies' race over C&D (6-1) three weeks ago; enters calculations.

runners_data.name: Havana Oaks
runners_data.spotlight: Fifth of nine on Newcastle AW debut in a 6f fillies' maiden (7-1) last October, but took a backward step at Southwell (5f; 33-1, last of five) a few weeks later; off for 224 days since so she couldn't be the pick on this turf debut; monitor only.

runners_data.name: Korbut
runners_data.spotlight: Tried to pinch it at Southwell (7f fillies' novice; 33-1) on second start, but couldn't hold off the winner; ran to a similar level when fifth over that trip at Wolverhampton since; now tackles 6f for turf debut.

runners_data.name: Havin A Flyer
runners_data.comment: Two sound runs in turf h'caps last year; on a good mark now; chance after 130-day break
runners_data.spotlight: 0-17; didn't look entirely straightforward when fourth over C&D (Powernap runner-up) 12 days ago; she could strip fitter for that comeback run though, and it's possible the added cheekpieces may suit.

runners_data.name: Gwen Tennyson
runners_data.comment: Ordinary form in maiden/novice on the AW over 5f/6f and best watched for now
runners_data.spotlight: Didn't offer much on first two starts but showed speed and she improved when third, to one who now has a mark of 72, in C&D novice (50-1) 12 days ago; switches to a handicap at an appropriate level; possibilities.

runners_data.name: Saxon Grace
runners_data.comment: 0-9 but not without promise in March for new yard and has each-way possibilities
runners_data.spotlight: Heavily supported on stable debut (sixth) on Wolverhampton AW in March and was only headed deep inside the final furlong when fourth at Carlisle (6f, good; 11-2) a fortnight ago; this sharp 5f could prove ideal.

runners_data.name: Enjoy The Night
runners_data.spotlight: Down the field in three novice/maiden events and it was a similar tale in added tongue-tie on handicap debut at Thirsk (5f; 28-1) last September; has left the Quinns since; hard to be interested in him back from an absence unless the market speaks favourably; has been gelded.

runners_data.name: Powernap
runners_data.comment: Took a step back in the right direction latest; each-way player if backing that up.
runners_data.spotlight: 0-10; runner-up in added tongue-tie over C&D (Havin A Flyer fourth) 12 days ago; occupied that same position at Wetherby (about 5f, good to firm) subsequently; consistent but has had plenty of chances.

runners_data.name: Brain Freeze
runners_data.comment: Her two best runs have come here but she is up in grade and out of the weights today
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark in a tight finish at Redcar (5f; good to firm; 12-1) latest; that form has taken a couple of hits (second and third soundly beaten since) and has more to do from this 3lb higher mark; the prospect of rain is also a legitimate concern.

runners_data.name: Sparkling Wine
runners_data.comment: Modest form in two runs 387 days apart; minor handicaps beckon
runners_data.spotlight: Sent off at big prices all three starts; only seventh of eight (beaten over 12l) in a 6f fillies' novice at Ripon (33-1) under a month ago; improvement necessary, even at this lowly level, on handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Tanaka
runners_data.comment: Well beaten on all four starts last term and needs to improve markedly; poor draw
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to beat a rival in two starts for Kevin Ryan, and has done little better since joining David O'Meara; it's tough to envisage her troubling Powernap or Havin A Flyer on recent C&D evidence; focus elsewhere.

races.name: Download The Raceday Ready App Handicap

runners_data.name: Equity Law
runners_data.comment: Again travelled strongly when sixth here 15 days ago and remains in good form
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner off 1lb higher last September; two good runs when third at Ripon in April (5f, good) and at Thirsk (5f, good to firm) last month but he hasn't done as well since.

runners_data.name: Isle Of Lismore
runners_data.comment: Returns from an absence but on a competitive mark and he's right at home on slow ground
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner in May 2021 (heavy); wasn't in top form last season so has dropped to a good mark but he was well beaten on soft at Haydock on reappearance.

runners_data.name: Le Beau Garcon
runners_data.spotlight: Four wins, the latest on reappearance at Ayr last May (5f, good); fair fourth on last month's Ripon reappearance (5f, good), although that form hasn't worked out; good second to Equity Law here last September and, with his stable going well, he's worth considering.

runners_data.name: Arctic Summer
runners_data.comment: Ex-French (won over 6f at Chantilly in 2024); going suits; not in top form; headgear tried
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-French; won over 6f at Chantilly in 2024 (very soft); rather disappointing since joining present yard, including at Carlisle on Tuesday when tried in cheekpieces (retained).

runners_data.name: Winchurch
runners_data.comment: Drawn to attack again and fine on Tapeta but an 8lb rise will test him into a deeper race
runners_data.spotlight: Effective at 5f/6f on turf and AW; easy winner at Nottingham in April (6f, good) for which he went back up 8lb; not so good on AW next time but has a chance back on turf.

runners_data.name: Glory Fighter
runners_data.comment: Made all at Nottingham last month and not disgraced at Ripon; should make another bold bid
runners_data.spotlight: Two of 11 wins have been over C&D; latest success was at Nottingham (5f, good) in April but rather disappointing since; has a bit to prove.

runners_data.name: Lucius Aurelius
runners_data.comment: 17th time lucky when winning at Catterick last month; 5lb rise might find him out
runners_data.spotlight: Record here is 2231, his win coming over 5f in April (good); can be forgiven a below-par effort next time after being restless in stalls; interesting back here.

races.name: Try Racing TV For Free Now Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Sixpack
runners_data.comment: Stays 1m6f and he battled on best to win over 1m4f at Doncaster last month; up 3lb
runners_data.spotlight: Three good runs this season, notably when winning off 3lb lower over 1m4f at Doncaster early last month (good to firm); stays 1m6f well; not disgraced on good to soft last time and one with a chance.

runners_data.name: Robert Johnson
runners_data.spotlight: Has won seven of his 23 races at up to 2m2f, including two over 1m4f here in 2023 and 2024; creditable 2l third of seven at Newbury on latest start in April 2025 when with Tracy Waggott; now 4lb lower and an interesting contender on stable debut despite 426-day absence.

runners_data.name: Lightning Tiger
runners_data.comment: Has won over this trip on turf; last month's Thirsk reappearance has been franked; hood on
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced; won over 1m4f here on handicap debut (soft) last October; fair form since and could go well, although he didn't run to his best on only previous try at this trip; hood on for second time.

runners_data.name: Baileys Khelstar
runners_data.comment: 1lb higher than for his last win, which came over this trip; this is easier than last time
runners_data.spotlight: Missed 2025 but proved he has retained his ability with two good runs this year, notably when second to an in-form stablemate of Sixpack over 2m at Newbury last time (good to firm); acts on any ground; can go well.

runners_data.name: Military Air
runners_data.comment: Ex-French; well beaten on stable debut at Pontefract (1m2f) last month
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-French; winner at Lyon Parilly on his debut in 2024 (1m, very soft) and third in a Longchamp Listed race (1m4f, good to soft) last year; bit disappointing since 45,000gns purchase last autumn but capable of better than he has shown in Britain.

runners_data.name: Gibside
runners_data.comment: On a good mark but needs to leave his four efforts this season a long way behind him
runners_data.spotlight: Two course wins, including this race off 8lb lower in 2024 (good to firm); highly tried and not been at his best this season but quite interesting down in grade.

runners_data.name: Vince Le Prince
runners_data.spotlight: Dual C&D winner on soft ground, the latest off a 6lb higher mark in October 2024; plenty of sound runs since (placed over C&D on four occasions); each-way chance.

runners_data.name: Qazaq
runners_data.comment: Trouble in running at Musselburgh on last two starts, going close on the first occasion
runners_data.spotlight: Won his first three races, over 7f/1m on the AW, when with Roger Varian; hasn't won since, although was beaten only a head when second at Musselburgh in April; not done quite as well since and was behind Tattie Bogle at Ayr last time (7f, good to firm).

runners_data.name: Tattie Bogle
runners_data.comment: Won for the first time on turf at Musselburgh in April; runner-up at Ayr 12 days ago.
runners_data.spotlight: Winner off a 2lb lower mark at Musselburgh in April (7f, good); two sound placed efforts on last two starts; solid run on only previous run here; chance.

runners_data.name: Uppercase
runners_data.comment: Promising start to career but his last two runs have seen his form dip; still low mileage
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced maiden; tends to pull hard but sound run when third at Yarmouth last time (7f, good); can make the running which would be an asset round here; interesting.

runners_data.name: In A Hurry
runners_data.comment: Two handicap placings but she's been right out of form in her three starts since
runners_data.spotlight: Won a Thirsk maiden last June (7f, good); good third over this C&D next time (good to firm) but has been very disappointing on her last four starts (two of them this season) so has plenty to prove at present.

runners_data.name: Imperial Guard
runners_data.comment: Yet to win for this trainer (0-11); readily outpaced on seasonal reappearance; visor on.
runners_data.spotlight: Only win was at Kempton in 2024 when with Andrew Balding; ran three sound races over 5f/6f for Michael Dods in May 2025; mainly disappointing since, including with cheekpieces (left off today) last time.

runners_data.name: Habrdi
runners_data.comment: Up-and-down profile but second over C&D recently and leading claims if backing that up
runners_data.spotlight: Only turf win was in a Brighton novice (6f, soft) for Jane Chapple-Hyam in October 2023; however, he has run two sound races to be placed at Ayr on last two starts (7f, good to firm); each-way chance.

runners_data.name: Jenni
runners_data.comment: 7f winner last spring but slow starts have become a big issue; looks risky back at 6f
runners_data.spotlight: Musselburgh winner off 8lb higher in May last year (7f, good); below par both runs in 2026; needs to bounce back.

runners_data.name: Coconut Bay
runners_data.comment: Most wins over 7f; disappointing at Catterick last time
runners_data.spotlight: Three wins last June/July including this race on good ground and another handicap over C&D on good to firm in July; creditable third at Ayr early last month but not so good since; makes a quick reappearance after a below-par run on soft ground on Monday (6f).

runners_data.name: Pouting
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-Richard Hughes; bought for 14,000gns last July; 11-race maiden; tailed off on only start for this yard (second run after wind op) last August; off since; best watched for now.
